- `vending_ext_startup_item_return` → `vending_ext_startup_par_review`, form **state**. policy_source "A return of a start-up item is not credited until the item's selection carries the start-up review par change entry from Corbett that its stockout between scheduled restock visits owes." — verbatim in the blocked policy's hub (startup_item_return_desk_reference_37970e3e, §Credit for returned start-up items, 5th paragraph). Connective "not … until" and state form intact. `grep -l` over docs/*/*.json: "not credited until", "start-up review par change", "stockout" occur only in that document → no other policy's document carries it.

## revision_3

### Scope and method
Cross-product re-judge with all seven products published (docs/credit 50, order 45, pricing 66, vmi 62, calibration 17, safety 21, vending 54). Every seeded row of another product in task 0's world was read through db_query.py (credit accounts/transactions/disputes/limit reviews, pricing agreement/items/claims/rebates, ship-tos, order lines/returns, StockSmart programs/bins/activity, safety, calibration, handoffs) and judged against that product's published rules. Vending corpus and source unchanged since revision_2.

### Conditionality of the round-1 PASS
Not conditional: the vending factor documents read credit, order, pricing and StockSmart records in the vocabulary those products now publish (statuses, returned payments by return date, shipped order lines per ship-to, new-bin/removal entries with VBR request references and critical flags, removal and substitute contract lines with change references). bijection and dependency-form verdicts unchanged.

### Seed rows judged (task 0 world)
Consistent with the other products' rules: Net 30 Standard due dates (+30), returned payment fees 35.00 and certified-funds payment methods, ar_balance 12209.80 = open INV-5220988 + INV-5217385 + INV-5217502 + INV-5220146; vending usage invoices equal the vending usage bills and the month's net vends per cost center; installation fee invoice 250.00 (Carousel 90); order prices at the contract price in effect, free freight (Route Delivery; Standard Ship-To subtotal 164.40 ≥ 150.00), minimum order met; removal PCH-552310 with 30 days' notice; substitute PCH-552311 at the discontinued item's 6.85 within the 90-day protection; competitive match PCH-552790 = 6.5500 (valid Category Contract match); VMI go-live 15 business days after enrolment (≤ 20).

Not producible by the other products' rules (source-side seed items; none moves 28 or 6.00):
- **SRC-4 (vmi/credit).** Credit invoices INV-5216112 9214.60 (VV-557104, 2026-07-29), INV-5218275 8876.35 (VV-557381, 2026-08-26) and INV-5220988 9402.10 (VV-557652, 2026-09-30), source type vmi_replenishment, one per month. StockSmart Weekly Service bills one replenishment invoice per visit (4 visits a month) for bins filled to max level at the contract price on the delivery date (service_visit_and_replenishment_schedule; bin_replenishment_and_billing 2.2, 3.1). VMI-55210's only bins (SF-51207 max 72 at 9.85, AB-50926 max 30 at 6.85, AB-53318 max 20 at 6.85) cannot bill more than about 3.7k a month, and no vmi_activity row (visit, delivery, replenishment billed) backs any of the three invoices.
- **SRC-5 (vmi).** VMI-55210 is a StockSmart Weekly Service program with 2 bins set at month end (gate: 300 bins, 100000.00 annual spend — tier_entry_gates_and_go_live), its SF-51207 bin (since 2024-05-06) has never been replenished yet survives the 3-monthly par reviews that remove bins non-moving for 9 months (bin_and_par_change_allowances; bin_changes_and_par_reviews), and months before 2026-07 with program spend below 8000.00 carry no 400.00 minimum fee (program_fee_rules 1; monthly_program_fee_schedule).
- **SRC-7 (pricing).** CPA-55107, a Corbett Category Contract: annual_spend_commitment 250000.00 where the tier's commitment written on the agreement is 75000.00 (tier_entry_and_commitment_schedule A.2; proposal_signature_and_first_term 1); expiration_date 2027-10-31 where a 12-month first term from 2025-11-01 ends 2026-10-31 and has not yet renewed at 2026-10-05 (term_renewal_termination_schedule; proposal 4); the agreement carries 3-4 contract items against the tier's smallest list of 25 (contract_item_list_rules (d); contract_item_list_schedule).
- **SRC-8 (order).** SO-5520117 line 1 (Corbett Standard Ship-To ST-51843, ground parcel, stocked) booked Tue 2026-09-08 08:41, before the 16:00 same-day cutoff, shipped 2026-09-10; the rule ships it the same business day (order_booking_pricing_shipping_terms 5; expedite_cutoff_route_schedule). INV-5219733 is dated on that ship date.
- **SRC-9 (order).** Ship-to anniversary reviews not recorded although the ship-tos were handled after the anniversary: ST-51842 (opened 2014-06-02, last_review_date 2025-06-02; orders 2026-06-22, 2026-09-15) and ST-51843 (opened 2016-03-14, last_review_date 2024-03-14 — two anniversaries; order 2026-09-08) (anniversary_service_level_review_desk_reference: recorded on the anniversary or the first later day the ship-to is handled).

Observation (not src): the Commercial Credit Account's periodic 12-month review (last_review_date 2025-06-16) is overdue at 2026-10-05; the credit documents state the cycle but tie the last review date only to approved limit decisions.
